storyCards.fact:
Winger's "Miles Away" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Miles Away was released in 1990.

Album: In The Heart Of The Young (1990).
